name: rdap-q
displayName: RDAP-Q: Adaptive Planning with Quality Gates
summary: Universal AI agent engineering protocol for evidence-first software development, calibrated scoring, and quality gates across Codex, Grok, Copilot, Antigravity, Goose, Claude, Cline, and Cursor.
description: Vendor-neutral Research-Driven Adaptive Planning with Quality Gates (RDAP-Q) enables autonomous AI coding agents to execute non-trivial software tasks with disciplined evidence collection, deterministic phase execution, persistent project state, calibrated quality scoring (0-10 scale), and diminishing-return exit logic. Native support for OpenAI Codex, xAI Grok, GitHub Copilot, Google Antigravity, Block Goose, Anthropic Claude, Cline, and Cursor.

commands./rdapq: Execute task using RDAP-Q. Default depth is lean.
commands./rdapq status: Show phase, depth, oracle Q, gates, and round.
commands./rdapq score: Show oracle Q. The 8-dimension card is a model label and is written only for this command.
commands./rdapq depth: Set lean, standard, or full. User switch wins.
commands./rdapq audit: Trigger the adversarial final-audit verification checklist.
commands./rdapq resume: Reload persistent project state and verify environment drift before continuing.
commands./rdapq memory: Query durable cross-session patterns, lessons, and constraints.
commands./rdapq research: Enter discovery. Implies standard or full for this task.
commands./rdapq explain: Explain the current depth, phase, or exit.
